verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a remote-desktop platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only a Teams API for automating deployment and pulling audit logs. It names no official SDK or client library. An HTTP API is an adjacent building block, not an SDK, so it earns no credit here. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
